data.long_meaning: The name Debojit is derived from Sanskrit words ‘Deba’ meaning god and ‘Jit’ meaning victory or gift. This name signifies that the child is a gift from the gods. The name is associated with the god Shiva and is believed to bring prosperity, strength, and success. The name Debojit carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Debojit usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: The name Debojit is a compound of two Sanskrit words - 'Deba' which means God and 'Jit' which means victory. It is believed that this name was given to warriors who had defeated their enemies and dedicated their victory to their deities. The name likely became popular during ancient Hindu warfare periods, such as the Mahabharata or the Gupta Empire.

historical_references.reference: Another reference to the name Debojit comes from the Puranic literature, where Debojit is the name of one of the ten incarnations of the god Vishnu known as the 'Ashtavakra'. He is said to have been born in the form of a deformed dwarf due to a curse from the sage Ashtavakra, but despite his appearance, he was wise and powerful. The name Debojit highlights his divine connection as a manifestation of the god who has secured victory over all obstacles.
